facts.fact: Matin Libre reports that on the government's service-public.bj portal, which carries more than 131 public services, an AI assistant called Yemi answers users around the clock.

systems.owner: Ministere de la Transformation Digitale et de l'Innovation

BEN.note: The voice services demonstrated in health and agriculture are demonstrations, not a tool in service in a public sector system.

facts.fact: Benin's J'aime ma langue project recorded 700 hours of Fongbe speech from 2,507 people in all 12 departments, and a speech recognition system built on it makes four times fewer errors than the best existing model; 19 voice services were demonstrated, per Matin Libre.

BEN.note: 20 communes handle mail electronically, an application with no connection stated; nothing on commune office connection.
